description: The death-rebirth capture's script for a fresh Corvin: he starts at the Village Entrance where creation leaves him, so `w`, `w` come before the capture's `d` into the arena (the captured Corvin had logged off on the Narrow Road). A level-1 Elf Mage (20 HP, no armour, no weapon) goes down into the arena and rests (accepted); then fights each spawn with bare hands until a monster knocks it below 0 HP (negative HP in the prompt; `rest` refused while mortally wounded), lies there until `You have been killed!`, then the miracle and lives lines, the rebirth room, `i` (empty) and `st`.
behaviours: a life is lost (lives count shown)
gear and coins stay in the death room (`i` empty)
DEATHHP -200: the unconscious window before death

mask.why: every direction name carries a random capital letter and a backspace, rewritten each slow cycle: `nJ\borth`
the prompt's numbers only, never its labels (as m4)

mask.regex: (?<=for )\d+(?= damage)|(?<=You gain )\d+(?= experience)|\d+(?= (?:copper farthings?|silver nobles?|gold crowns?|platinum pieces?|runic coins?)\b)
mask.why: RNG: the damage, the experience share and the coin amounts, digits only (the words and the currency name stay compared)
the experience after random fights (st, exp): the number and its column padding, not the label
current hit points after random fights (st): the number and its padding, not the label or the maximum
experience still needed and its percentage (exp): digits only

notes: No sysop commands were used: Corvin rested, then fought back with fists until killed.

A first attempt that only rested was stopped after ten minutes: the arena's giant rat never hurt Corvin (`The fat giant rat lunges at you!` only). Its broken connection was cleared by a login (not captured) before this run, so no punishment lines appear here.

Up to 25 fight rounds (m2.repeat over the one stored round, steps 9-13): only the arena's acid slime reliably hurts a level-1 character (the others hit at the 10% floor and are mostly dodged), about one spawn in eight, so eight rounds left a third of the runs without a death (#72, run 39015886068); the rounds after the knockout are skipped (`skip_if`).

steps.until: into the room|at you|you for \d+|Also here:

steps.note: waits for the room's exits line, not the first prompt: a monster's line and its prompt can come before the room text, and `Also here` must be in this step (live runs 38953732059, 38988606081)
fists; a monster already gone (`You don't see`) ends the cycle
to the end of the fight or the knockout; a fight still on after 300 s goes to the next step

a slow fight: fists (1-2 damage, most blows glancing off its armour) against a monster that regenerates (slow_update_monster) and hits a dodging mage at the 10% floor: the new side's filthbug was still up after 300 s (live run 39030247260). Nothing else spawns meanwhile (the arena spawns only while its players outnumber its monsters), so the cycle waits the fight out. Once per run (`slow`, set by any output of this wait), so the worst case stays well inside the nightly cleanup (CLEANUP_AT); a later slow fight goes on to the next cycle
